reason: I have one apartment and Booking already sends my scheduled messages, and the house-rules sheet on the table answers the rest. On about eight thousand a year, €120 for something that answers the same three questions I already answer myself doesn't make sense.
objection: My guests ask about Wi-Fi, parking and check-out, and I'm right next door anyway. I don't see what time it saves me that a printed sheet doesn't already.
would_change_my_mind: If I started getting a lot of messages at night or in languages I can't handle, so it was actually costing me sleep or reviews.
